rect.data-description: the readout window, two seven-segment cells; each cell's glyph set is on its digit.

g.data-description: the left digit. Its states are the characters a seven-segment cell can form, each naming the segments it lights - a top, b top-right, c bottom-right, d bottom, e bottom-left, f top-left, g middle.
the right digit. Its states are the characters a seven-segment cell can form, each naming the segments it lights - a top, b top-right, c bottom-right, d bottom, e bottom-left, f top-left, g middle.
